purpose: PF-BETA-11 Exotic-first prototype overlay. Ownership candidates only; rawDim remains the literal extracted DIM payload. Gameplay claims require explicit evidence.

anchorEvidence.buildFocus: Void grenade pressure and Devour sustain: Chaos Accelerant enhances Scatter Grenade, whose Void ability final blows can activate Feed the Void.

synergyChains.evidence: Bungie Update 8.0.0.1: Chaos Accelerant Scatter Grenade increased submunition tracking consistency and tracking duration, confirming that the equipped Chaos Accelerant aspect directly enhances the equipped Scatter Grenade.

Manifest-derived Scatter Grenade hash 1514173218 is the equipped Void grenade ability. Bungie Update 3.4.0: Feed the Void grants Devour on any Void ability kill. Therefore a Scatter Grenade final blow is a qualifying producer for Feed the Void.

mutationCases.evidence: Magnetic Grenade hash 1547656727 occurs inside the Alpha library and its manifest description is a grenade that attaches and explodes twice. It is not Scatter Grenade, so replacing Scatter Grenade removes the Chaos Accelerant -> enhanced Scatter Grenade chain asserted for hash 1514173218.
